# IStakingRewards
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/sky/IStakingRewards.sol)

**Title:**
IStakingRewards

Interface for a Synthetix-style staking rewards distributor (as used by Sky)


## Functions
### balanceOf

Returns the staked balance of an account


```solidity
function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The staked balance|


### earned

Returns the rewards earned but not yet claimed by an account


```solidity
function earned(address account) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The account to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The earned reward amount|

### exit

Withdraws the caller's entire staked balance and claims rewards


```solidity

```

### getReward

Claims the caller's accrued rewards


```solidity
function getReward() external;
```

### stake

Stakes `amount` of the staking token for the caller


```solidity
function stake(uint256 amount) external;
```

|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount to stake|
